steps: Actual Build Mode opens on localhost with the saved furniture; playback is stopped.
Pointer drag creates an actual wall.
Wall drawing supports undo and redo.
Rectangle drag creates four walls and a 12 m² enclosed floor.
Valid doorway and wall/floor colours update through the UI.
Furniture can be placed inside the room.
Normal Save writes the real Convex development backend and preserves existing furniture/history.
Page refresh reconstructs the same saved building and furniture.
A prior saved design can be loaded as a draft; Undo restores the current building without another save.
Phone-size layout exposes touch-sized construction controls (not a physical-device test).
Village simulation state stays unchanged; no uncaught browser errors.
playback: Stopped in UI; no Play/Advance command executed
